# Saad Shams — Shopify Developer & Web Developer in Pakistan

> Saad Shams is a Shopify developer and freelance web developer based in Pakistan. He builds ecommerce websites, Shopify stores, WordPress sites and React web apps for businesses in Pakistan, the UK and worldwide, and works remotely with clients anywhere in Pakistan.

## Services

- Ecommerce website development on Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce
- Custom Shopify theme development and customization
- Liquid sections and blocks, metafields and metaobjects
- AJAX cart and Shopify Cart API work, bundle builders, product calculators
- Shopify Flow automations and B2B trade setups
- Shipping configuration, store speed and SEO fixes
- WordPress and WooCommerce sites (including Elementor)
- React and Node.js web applications

## Selected work

- [Quick Foam](https://quickfoam.co.uk/): UK foam supplier. Cut-to-size foam calculator inside the Shopify theme, covering 20+ shapes with live pricing and cutting details sent to the workshop.
- [Zonky](https://zonky.uk/): Shopify store for a modular kids' play sofa brand.
- [Game Over](https://gameoverstore.co.uk/): Shopify store for gaming bean bags and loungers.
- [Ready Steady Bed](https://readysteadybed.co.uk/): Shopify store for children's beds, bedding and play furniture.
- [Blonde Clothing](https://blondeclo.com/): Shopify streetwear store.
